scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:cli && npm run test:mcp
scripts.test:cli: npm --workspace @deplens/cli test && node packages/cli/bin/deplens.js zod --types --filter ZodString
scripts.test:coverage: npm --workspace @deplens/core run test:coverage && npm run test:cli && npm run test:mcp
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint:check && npm run test:types && npm run test:coverage && npm audit --audit-level=moderate && npm pack --workspaces --dry-run
scripts.publish:all: npm --workspace @deplens/core publish --access public && npm --workspace @deplens/cli publish --access public && npm --workspace @deplens/mcp publish --access public
